proof_scope: Live canonical-document editing: CLI document-op with create-figure/create-svg generation, Vite API, real browser UI (Surf) for Insert menu, clipboard paste, crop and delete; PPTX reopened for crop and generated images

claims.proves: Elements/slides can be added, duplicated, moved, deleted; images arrive by file, paste, create-figure chart, or create-svg diagram with required alt text; crop persists to the document and the delivered PPTX; rejected ops write nothing
claims.does_not_prove: Publication approval of generated illustrations, legacy YAML bundle parity, drag-drop from the OS file manager, or Google Slides fidelity
